WP364 immutable parent baseline provenance

source_commit: b9f16ae600931020deb06dab2b7adc9d50152428
source_commit_subject: docs: settle the five choices the spec was still leaving to whoever typed first
source_commit_time: 2026-08-30T12:25:57+09:00

This commit is the implementation-free HEAD named before any WP364 source or
test edit.  It is not HEAD^ of the eventual worktree.

Capture procedure (2026-08-30):

1. Clone the working repository with `git clone --shared --no-checkout` into a
   separate directory and detach at the source_commit above.
2. Hash the four checked-in engine SPIR-V byte streams with SHA-256.
3. In a compiler-ON build, compile each unchanged engine GLSL source under its
   production `engine://<resource filename>` name with an enabled ShaderCompiler cache and record the
   non-empty cache_key returned by the parent implementation.
4. In the detached parent, compose hybrid_v1 with rt_shadow_mask and
   rt_shadow_mask_pipeline, run parseFrameGraphDefinitionsFromConfigJson,
   planFrameGraph, and framePlanToJson, then retain the declared canonical
   projection in parent_baseline.json.  The capture test was added only to the
   detached clone; the checked-in fixture is never regenerated by tests.
5. Project tree hashes use sorted relative paths and the canonical stream
   `[u64 path byte count][path bytes][u64 file byte count][file bytes]`.

The empty-scene R8 GPU value records the already checked-in parent assertion:
32x32 bytes, every byte 0xff.  Per the integration instruction, no GPU test was
executed while capturing WP364; this is therefore a frozen behavioral oracle,
not a fresh device capture.  The final WP364 report must keep that distinction.

The implementation and tests may read these fixtures, but must never rewrite
or bless them from current output.

2026-08-30 integration amendment: parent_baseline.json's per-project
{file_count, sha256} measured the WHOLE working directory, which counts
untracked local artifacts (caches, saves) and therefore differs between
a clean worktree and a long-lived checkout. Replaced by
parent_manifest.json (version 2): per-file sha256 of the files TRACKED
at the same frozen commit b9f16ae600931020deb06dab2b7adc9d50152428,
generated mechanically from git blobs of that commit by the integrator
(not by the implementation). Shipped-bytes invariance means these
tracked files are unchanged; untracked neighbors are out of scope.

2026-08-30 autocrlf ruling: this checkout has core.autocrlf=true, so
tracked text files sit on disk as CRLF while the committed blob is LF.
"Shipped bytes unchanged" means the COMMITTED blob is unchanged, not the
local CRLF checkout representation. Rejected: a repo-wide .gitattributes
forcing LF checkout (heavy, would touch every checkout and risk golden/
other fixtures). Adopted: parent_manifest.json version 3 carries git's
own per-file eol classification (lf|binary); the test normalizes
working-tree CRLF->LF for eol==lf entries before hashing and compares
eol==binary entries raw. 70 text + 5 binary files. Manifest generated
mechanically from git blobs + `git ls-files --eol` by the integrator.

2026-09-19 integration amendment: C-8 (commit d64a2db1) split GameContext
into a root plus physics / audio / animation / save / render facades, so two
shipped project sources changed by hand: projects/example/code/playercontrol.cpp
(the four light setters moved to render()) and
projects/sprite_demo/code/flipbook_demo.cpp (setCamera moved to render()).
Their blob_sha256 / blob_bytes entries in parent_manifest.json are re-frozen
from `git show HEAD:<path> | sha256sum` at that commit. No other entry, no
cache key and no frame plan projection changed. The engine shader universe
is untouched (the C-10 GLSL resource was withdrawn for exactly that reason).

2026-09-24 integration amendment: PG-1 (commit 533d8d6c) added
`"requires": ["physics"]` to projects/sprite_demo/project.json, since the
demo's scene carries colliders and its code tests the ground. That entry's
blob_sha256 / blob_bytes are re-frozen from `git show HEAD:<path> | sha256sum`
(962 -> 989 bytes). No other entry, no cache key and no frame plan
projection changed.
